Name: Porcelaine's Wizard (CP)
Author: FawnGlade
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=1][color=#f4cccc]This is just a Content Patcher version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1940]Porcelaine's Wizard Portrait[/url]﻿.[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]I really always loved that portrait and sprite version, so I decided to give it a shot into making it avaliable for CP. :D[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]These assets are also compatible with Looking for Love.[/color]

[color=#d9ead3][size=2]✧༺[color=#f4cccc]♥[/color]༻∞　﻿[/size][/color][/size][size=1][color=#d9ead3][size=2]༶•┈┈⛧┈[color=#f4cccc]♛[/color] [color=#f4cccc]♛[/color]┈⛧┈┈•༶　∞༺[color=#f4cccc]♥[/color]༻✧[/size][/color]
[/size]
[font=Verdana][color=#b4a7d6][size=3][u][color=#d9ead3]Installation[/color][/u][color=#d9ead3] [u]&[/u] [u]Configuration[/u][/color]
[/size][/color][/font][/center][center][color=#f4cccc][size=1]This mod requires [u]SMAPI[/u] and [u]Content Patcher[/u].

Open the downloaded file and just drag and drop the folder into the Mods folder, easy peasy!
Once you open your game via SMAPI a new config file will appear. Just drag and drop it into a text editor if you'd like do pick the options!
The values should be as follows:

[b][u]EnableMod[/u]: [/b]true or false - Just set the more to active or inactive.﻿[/size][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][size=1][color=#f4cccc][size=1][b][u]OverworldSprite[/u]: [/b]young or vanilla - Modify the overworld sprite only.[/size][/color]
﻿[/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=1][color=#f4cccc][size=1][color=#f4cccc][size=1][b][u]Portrait[/u]: [/b]enabled or disable - Modify the portrait only.

[/size][/color][/size][/color][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=1]The mod is is set as active by default.

﻿[/size][/color][size=1][color=#d9ead3][size=2]✧༺[color=#f4cccc]♥[/color]༻∞　﻿[/size][/color][/size][size=1][color=#d9ead3][size=2]༶•┈┈⛧┈[color=#f4cccc]♛[/color] [color=#f4cccc]♛[/color]┈⛧┈┈•༶　∞༺[color=#f4cccc]♥[/color]༻✧

[size=1][color=#f4cccc]Mod created originally by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50982931]PorcelaineBones[/url]﻿ and reuploaded for CP [i][u][b]with permission.[/b][/u][/i]
The same rules of the original mod page applies, so please don't copy, modify or redistribute without PorcelaineBones permission![/color][/size][/center]
